gen-gf-anek-malayalam-fs-erode: Anek Malayalam has chunky, tall lowercase letters, each e looking wide awake. Erode follows with a tall middle band and a gentle ebb and flow of stroke weight, the kind of classic serif that rewards a slower look.
gen-gf-anek-malayalam-fs-karma: Modern and plain-spoken, Anek Malayalam sets chunky letters up top. Karma, a text serif with terminals finishing well clear of the stem, brings a quiet modulation that never snags the eye, and that gentle, trustworthy hand is what holds the pair together.
gen-gf-anek-odia-fs-erode: Anek Odia draws its lowercase very large, every bowl left open. Its sans-serif heading does best at being bold and direct, while Erode, a classic serif with arches that thin slowly into lighter joins, does best at a dignified, unhurried pace.
gen-gf-anek-odia-fs-karma: Karma is a text serif with terminals that finish well clear of the stem, drawn as if by a barely tilted calligraphy nib. Anek Odia above it is contemporary and open, so the page moves from wide bowls to a tidy classic hand.
gen-gf-anek-tamil-fs-karma: Karma holds its x-height close to its cap height, with terminals that stop well short of the stem. A longer read feels trustworthy and steady, never snagging.
gen-gf-anek-telugu-fs-erode: Erode reads with a tall middle band and a gentle ebb and flow of stroke weight, which smooths the pace. Anek Telugu does best at crisp, clog-free shapes, while Erode handles sustained reading.
gen-gf-anek-telugu-fs-karma: Karma is a text serif with a calm, classic hand. Anek Telugu does best at clean shapes that never clog at low resolution and a big lowercase, while Karma does best at a mild thick-thin pace that smooths the reading.
gen-gf-anton-sc-fs-karma: Anton SC crowds its nearly cap-sized lowercase until neighbors almost collide. Karma, a text serif, answers with generous room and a gentle stroke contrast, so the tight, shouting heading sits against a body that feels trustworthy and unhurried.
gen-gf-antonio-fs-erode: Contemporary Antonio packs big open counters into a tight, close-set rhythm of letters. And Erode, a classic serif with a tall middle band and a modest stem-to-hairline ratio, would carry a longer passage with dignified, editorial ease.
gen-gf-anuphan-fs-erode: Erode leans editorial and dignified, with a tall middle band. If you size anything, give this serif body a little extra size, since its shallow ascenders and descenders let it take that gracefully beside Anuphan.
